courses.title: Amasomo
courses.description: Menya neza amategeko y'umuhanda mu Rwanda unyuze mu masomo ateguye neza yateguwe na Moto Sensei. Kuva ku rwego rw'abatangiye kugeza ku rwego rwo hejuru.
courses.no_courses_found: Nta masomo abonetse muri iki cyiciro.
courses.require_quiz_access_desc: Gura Uburenganzira bwa Quiz (1,000 RWF) kugira ngo ufungure amasomo n'inyigisho zose.

course_detail.instructor_expertise: Inzobere mu mategeko y'umuhanda no kwigisha umutekano wo mu muhanda mu Rwanda
